benefits: Easy Integration with Vercel AI SDK v5/v6

tools.name: tavilySearch
tools.description: Search the web for real-time information using Tavily's AI-optimized search engine. Returns relevant sources, snippets, and optional AI-generated answers.

tools.name: tavilyExtract
tools.description: Extract clean, structured content from one or more URLs. Returns parsed content in markdown or text format, optimized for AI consumption.

tools.name: tavilyCrawl
tools.description: Crawl a website starting from a base URL to discover and extract content from multiple pages. Intelligently traverses links and extracts structured data at scale.

tools.name: tavilyMap
tools.description: Map the structure of a website starting from a base URL. Discovers pages, links, and site hierarchy without extracting full content. Ideal for understanding site architecture.

fco_proposal.note: Tavily AI SDK output must not write directly to canonical FCG state.
